scholarships.title: University of Sharjah Research Assistant (RA) and Teaching Assistant (TA) Scholarship for Master's Students

existing.description: The University of Sharjah offers work-based Research Assistant and Teaching Assistant scholarships to eligible master's students, who must commit 20 hours per week at the University and may not be employed elsewhere during the scholarship period. The award is awarded by the concerned academic department based on its academic and research needs and available opportunities. The official page read does not publish the benefit amount, whether tuition is waived, or any list of expenses the scholarship covers, so this record is deliberately left unquantified rather than assumed to be full funding.
eligibility: Hold a Bachelor's degree with a minimum CGPA of 3.20 out of 4.00 (or equivalent) for UAE national students, and 3.60 out of 4.00 (or equivalent) for non-national students.
Be committed to working 20 hours per week at the University as part of the scholarship requirements.
Not be employed outside the University during the scholarship period.
Meet any additional requirements established by the concerned academic department and the University.

Regular master's admission also requires a bachelor's degree or equivalent from a university recognized by the UAE Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research (MoHESR), a minimum CGPA of 3.00 out of 4.00, and a bachelor's degree in a field relevant to the intended master's program.
existing.eligibility_summary: Master's students holding a bachelor's degree with a minimum CGPA of 3.60 out of 4.00 for non-nationals or 3.20 for UAE nationals, committed to 20 hours of work per week at the University and not employed outside it.
coverage: No coverage list is published on the official page read. The page states only that the University offers Research Assistant (RA) and Teaching Assistant (TA) scholarships to eligible Master's students, subject to the University's applicable bylaws, regulations, and available opportunities.
requirements: Scholarship eligibility and continuation are subject to the bylaws and regulations of the University of Sharjah.
Remedial courses are not covered by the scholarship.
Meeting the minimum eligibility requirements does not guarantee the award of a scholarship; selection is subject to departmental evaluation, availability, and approval.
The concerned academic department reserves the right to select eligible candidates based on its academic and research needs and the applicable selection criteria.
Applicants to Master's programs taught in English must obtain TOEFL iBT 79, TOEFL PBT 550, or IELTS Academic 6.0.
The University does not accept Home Edition or other online home-based English language proficiency examinations.

Applicants nominated for admission must reserve their seat by paying AED 10,000 within the specified deadline; the amount paid is applied toward tuition fees upon enrollment, and on withdrawal or non-enrollment AED 5,000 is non-refundable.
documents: Valid Passport - Copy of a valid passport.
Academic Qualifications - A certified copy of the Bachelor's Degree Certificate and Bachelor's Academic Transcript.
Personal Photograph - Recent passport-size color photograph.
Emirates ID - Copy of a valid UAE National Identity Card (Emirates ID).
UAE National Family Book - Copy of the UAE National Family Book, where applicable.
English Language Proficiency - A valid IELTS Academic, TOEFL iBT, or PTE Academic certificate; or official proof that the Bachelor's degree was taught in English.
Academic Recommendation Letters - Two recommendation letters from professors who taught or supervised the applicant during their Bachelor's degree studies.
UoS Alumni Card - Required for University of Sharjah graduates, where applicable.
Certificate recognition/equivalency from the UAE Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research (MoHESR) for qualifications obtained outside the United Arab Emirates.
Kuwait Embassy Cultural Office approval letter - for Kuwaiti applicants.
Employment Letter - applicants who are currently employed must submit a letter from their employer confirming current employment.
existing.english_requirement: Applicants to Master's programs taught in English must obtain one of the following minimum scores: TOEFL iBT 79; TOEFL PBT 550; IELTS Academic 6.0. Applicants to the Master of Applied Sociology, Master in Private Law, Master in Public Law, Master in Conservation Management of Cultural Heritage, and Master of Arts in Applied Criminology and Criminal Justice must either obtain a minimum TOEFL ITP score of 450, or its equivalent, or a minimum IELTS Academic score of 4.5, or successfully complete the prescribed English language course (ESL - 0 credit hours) during the first semester; students who do not satisfy the requirement by the end of the first semester will not be permitted to continue in the program. For Master's programs taught in Arabic, English language proficiency is not required unless specifically required by the selected program. English language proficiency test results are valid for two years from the date of the examination. The University does not accept Home Edition or other online home-based English language proficiency examinations.
application_method: Discover your program and select a college to view the master's programs and specializations offered.
Check your eligibility against the regular and conditional master's admission requirements.
Complete the required English language test, or provide official proof the bachelor's degree was taught in English.
Get your documents ready (passport, certified bachelor's certificate and transcript, photograph, Emirates ID, recommendation letters, MoHESR equivalence where applicable).
Explore scholarships and benefits, including RA/TA scholarship eligibility and the programme exclusion list.

Submit the online application through the University of Sharjah Online Admission Portal, upload all required documents, and pay the AED 500 non-refundable application fee between 5 October 2026 and 12 November 2026.
If nominated for admission, reserve the seat by paying AED 10,000 within the specified deadline.
existing.selection_notes: The concerned academic department reserves the right to select eligible candidates based on its academic and research needs and the applicable selection criteria. Selection is subject to departmental evaluation, availability, and approval; meeting the minimum eligibility requirements does not guarantee the award of a scholarship.
existing.best_fit: Master's applicants with a very high undergraduate CGPA — 3.60 out of 4.00 for non-nationals, 3.20 for UAE nationals — who can commit 20 hours a week and are not employed elsewhere, and who can apply to a programme that is not on the published exclusion list.
existing.notes: The scholarship carries a 20 hours-per-week work commitment at the University, and the holder must not be employed outside the University during the scholarship period. Remedial courses are not covered. Nine master's programmes are barred from RA/TA eligibility (all five Master of Dental Surgery programmes, Master of Science in Leadership in Health Professions Education, Master of Leadership in Higher Education, Executive Master in Business Administration, Doctor of Pharmacy (PharmD)), and the Master of Science in Molecular Medicine and Translational Research is eligible for Research Assistant scholarship only. No deferral, renewal, return-home or clinical-restriction terms are published. No tuition, housing, insurance or travel coverage is stated on the official page read, and the AED 500 application fee and AED 10,000 seat reservation are not described as scholarship-covered.
existing.duration: Tied to enrolment in a full master's degree programme; continuation is subject to the bylaws and regulations of the University of Sharjah. No scholarship duration is published.
existing.application_period: Master's applications are open 5 October 2026 to 12 November 2026 for the published 2026/2027 intake. The University publishes no separate RA/TA scholarship application window; it states that meeting the minimum eligibility requirements does not guarantee a scholarship and that selection is subject to departmental evaluation, availability and approval.
existing.deadline_display: Applications for Master's programs will be open from 5 October 2026 to 12 November 2026.
